## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. [Method](../method.md)

<pre>
source                         results  share of the score
<a name="report-2512.13607v2"></a><a href="https://arxiv.org/html/2512.13607v2">NVIDIA (lab)</a>                         3   99% ▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇
prior: pull toward the middle             1% ▇
weighted average                        = 59.4
</pre>

### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~19.85GB
llama cli -hf bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~34.82GB
llama cli -hf bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~19.85GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~34.82GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~18.4GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q4 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~34.8GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q8 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit q4_k_m · ~19.85GB
ollama run hf.co/bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit q8_0 · ~34.82GB
ollama run hf.co/bartowski/nvidia_OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**MLX (Mac)** · install: with uv `uv tool install mlx-lm` · or `pip install mlx-lm` · Apple silicon Macs only, text only.

```sh
# 4-bit mlx-4bit · mac only · ~18.4GB
mlx_lm.chat --model litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q4
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q4
# 4-bit mlx-8bit · mac only · ~34.8GB
mlx_lm.chat --model litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q8
# or start an OpenAI-compatible server at http://localhost:8080/v1
mlx_lm.server --model litmudoc/OpenReasoning-Nemotron-32B-MLX-Q8
```
